name: Sayonara, Space Rocks
storyline:
Welcome Star Pilot, to the Adios, Asteroids program. You’ve been asked here to lend your skills to clear the anomalous Orter-Egam Asteroid Belt. There’s something strange out there, and we need you to help make way for the armada to get through.

You’ll be remotely piloting a series of Earth Space Federation (ESF) Class A drones. These drones are simple to control and feature autofire cannons, small ordinance bombs, rechargeable shields, and the ability to wrap itself around local space. Furthermore, the onboard client of our HALICE hive computer, will track your performance and award points accordingly. She has also added a Bonus Roulette system designed to help and encourage our Star Pilots through the distribution of power ups and prizes. Now get out there, and become the pride of the ESF!
summary:
Sayonara, Space Rocks is a supercharged retro-modern homage to the classics that upends the experience with a bonus roulette system with each level.

You're a new Star Pilot recruit for the Earth Space Federation's (ESF) Sayonara, Space Rocks Program. You have been tasked with clearing the Egam-Oter Asteroid Belt of asteroids and a host of other unidentified anomalies by piloting a series of Class-A ESF drones supported by onboard clients of the HALICE hive computer.

The program features one or two player simultaneous expanded arcade action. With each level, the speed and your score multiplier increases, and you enter Bonus Time; a roulette system with thousands of combinations and over 50 unique gameplay perks and prizes. Over the course of a game, you'll face strange enemies and bosses, save humans, blast a lot of asteroids, and hopefully score a lot of points. In additions to the core game experience, you'll earn a slew of achievements, can visit "My Room" to customize your player card and view your rank and trophies, and sharpen your skills in the two-player Practice Mode.

As you progress, you can further customize your experience with unlockable player ship sprites, backgrounds, music, and asteroid color themes for thousands of combinations.
